concepts.name: 桂月团圆
concepts.description: 月夜靛蓝、桂花金与暖玉白；国风月窗和桂枝。
concepts.art: Refined Chinese festival storybook illustration: deep moonlit indigo, osmanthus gold, warm jade-white candidate surfaces, delicate brushed gold outlines and very small osmanthus sprigs. An original friendly adult female tiger kemonomimi mascot, chibi styled, human face, orange hair with dark tiger-stripe accents, round orange-and-black tiger ears, amber eyes, ringed tail; wearing a modest cream and navy hanfu collar, gold osmanthus hairpin and tiny bell. She leans on a moon-arc corner, holding a small mooncake. Elegant calm warmth, a partial circular moon form and cloud curls only at outer corners, fine painted shading. Avoid crowded red-and-gold festival clichés.

concepts.description: 青竹与雾白，轻水墨留白；安静清爽的日常皮肤。
